attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), created /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf with `blacklist usb-storage` and `install usb-storage /bin/false`, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the setting is active in early boot, verified the module cannot be loaded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed via a changed boot_id and fresh uptime that the blacklist persists and usb-storage remains blocked after reboot.
